summary: v0.3.1 is shipped: RealmEye live sync, per-enemy drop tables, self-updating data, the where-you-are overlay, Ctrl+K search and tray/startup all work and pass CI. Next up is proving location detection on a real PC and finishing the 2026-10 meta follow-ups.

needsYou.text: Run the game once with the app open, then open Overlay → "What the game log says"
needsYou.why: Only a real Player.log tells us whether Exalt names your location — I'll turn what it shows into an auto-detect pattern for everyone.

needsYou.text: Confirm the transparent overlay + dungeon quick-pick (Ctrl+Shift+...) behave on your setup
needsYou.why: Focus/click-through can't be checked from a Linux container.

needsYou.text: Pick the next big feature from the queue (or veto some)
needsYou.why: So I build what you'll actually use.
